title: Defense witness admits being 'partner in name' at accounting firm

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippine – Davao City accountant, Vingelin Bajan, admitted before the Senate impeachment court on Tuesday that she was only a “partner in name” at an accounting firm linked to companies of Vice President Sara Duterte and her spouse, Atty. Manases Carpio. Bajan was called to the witness stand by the defense team during the 41st day of Duterte’s impeachment trial to refute the prosecution’s allegation that the latter received compensation from the Davao City government in 2023 while already serving as vice president.
